fields.name: Action Replay File ID
fields.description: Public-facing file number used by Action Replay catalog systems. Keep it short, collectible, and stable after release.

fields.name: Action Replay Release Code
fields.description: Drop or release identifier used for catalog sorting, receipt text, and old-system file labels.

fields.name: Action Replay Archive Status
fields.description: Current catalog state for the product as an Action Replay file.

fields.name: Action Replay Classification
fields.description: System-style object class. Use this to make product pages feel like loaded files instead of generic listings.

fields.name: Action Replay System Note
fields.description: Short note written like a catalog terminal found the product. Keep it specific and human, not marketing copy.
fields.example: first live file after the access gate. sleeve mark survived the bad export.

fields.name: Action Replay Drop Window
fields.description: Loose release window for the file. Prefer YYYY-MM, TBA, or CLOSED.

fields.name: Action Replay Access Tier
fields.description: Access state for future shop/account rules. This is not a marketing tier; it is a system gate label.

fields.name: Action Replay Artifact Index
fields.description: Numeric order for artifact/file sorting across catalog, archive, account, and future drops.
